notes: All 21 source morphemes and 26 target tokens are partitioned exactly once.
*And when* is one waw's rendering headed on the coordinator (rule 55); the second waw, for which the ASV writes no connective, is `unrepresented`.

*said unto him* gives the supplied preposition to the verb, since the object it reaches is the verbal suffix and no preposition morpheme stands in the clause (rule 44); the supplied *of* of *of whom I spake* is placed on the same footing.
Both margins (*of whom I said unto thee, This same etc.* and the Hebrew gloss *answered him*) were read and set aside (rule 38).
